description: Field mapping between MT942 (Interim Transaction Report) and camt.052.001.10 (BankToCustomerAccountReportV10). MT942 is used by financial institutions to provide intraday transaction information without opening/closing balances. camt.052 is the ISO 20022 XML equivalent for interim account reports.
mapping_notes: MT942 uses SWIFT character set (ASCII-based), while camt.052 supports full Unicode. Character set conversion may be required.
MT942 field lengths are generally shorter than camt.052 equivalents. MT to MX translation is usually lossless, but MX to MT may require truncation.
MT942 uses comma as decimal separator (e.g., 12345,67), while camt.052 uses period (e.g., 12345.67)
MT942 field 61 (Statement Line) can repeat multiple times, mapping to multiple Ntry (Entry) elements in camt.052
MT942 field 86 (Information to Account Owner) provides additional details for the preceding field 61, mapping to Ntry/NtryDtls/TxDtls or Ntry/AddtlNtryInf
MT942 has NO opening/closing balance fields (60F/60M/62F/62M) unlike MT940. Focus is on transaction activity only.
MT942 has floor limit indicator (34F) and date/time indication (13D) which are unique to interim reporting
MT942 summary totals (90D/90C) include ALL transactions - both above and below floor limit - providing complete picture
Field 61 D/C marks map to camt.052 CdtDbtInd: C->CRDT (credit), D->DBIT (debit), RC->CRDT with reversal indicator, RD->DBIT with reversal indicator
MT942 transaction type codes (field 61 position after amount) use SWIFT Bank Transaction Codes (e.g., NCHK, NTRF) which should be preserved in camt.052 Prtry/Tp
Date conversion: MT942 uses YYMMDD format, camt.052 uses ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DD format with century inference (YY >= 50 -> 19YY, YY < 50 -> 20YY)
Time conversion: MT942 field 13D uses YYMMDD+HHMM format (local time), camt.052 uses ISO 8601 date-time format with timezone

mappings.transform_details: MT942 field 20 (Report Reference) maps to Report Identification. This is the unique reference assigned by the account servicing institution for the interim report.
mappings.notes: MT942 field 20 is max 16 chars, camt.052 Rpt/Id max 35 chars. No truncation needed for MT->MX. MX->MT may require truncation if > 16 chars.
mappings.truncation_rule: If MX Rpt/Id > 16 chars, truncate to 16 chars for MT field 20

mappings.transform_details: MT942 field 25 account number maps to Report Account Identification. If account matches IBAN format (starts with 2-letter country code + 2 check digits), use Acct/Id/IBAN element; otherwise use Acct/Id/Othr/Id.
mappings.notes: Validate account format to determine IBAN vs other account number. Field 25 max 35 chars matches MX limits.

mappings.transform_details: MT942 field 25 account number maps to IBAN element if the account matches IBAN format. Validate using country code check and Mod-97 algorithm.
mappings.notes: IBAN validation: starts with 2-letter ISO 3166 country code + 2 check digits, passes Mod-97 validation. If valid, use IBAN element; otherwise use Othr/Id.

mappings.transform_details: MT942 field 25P format is BIC/Account. The account portion (after /) maps to Acct/Id/IBAN or Othr/Id based on format validation. The BIC portion maps to Rpt/Acct/Svcr/FinInstnId/BICFI.
mappings.notes: Field 25P is alternative to field 25. Parse: extract BIC (before /), extract account (after /). Validate account for IBAN format.

mappings.transform_details: MT942 field 25P BIC component (before /) maps to Account Servicer Financial Institution BIC. This identifies the institution holding the account.
mappings.notes: Extract BIC from field 25P by taking characters before the / separator. BIC is 8 or 11 characters.

mappings.transform_details: MT942 field 28C report number (before optional /) maps to Legal Sequence Number. This is the sequential interim report number for the day.
mappings.notes: Field 28C format: ReportNumber[/SequenceNumber]. Extract first part (before /) for LglSeqNb. Second part (after /) is page/sequence within report.

examples.notes: Report 3, page 2 - page number goes to ElctrncSeqNb

mappings.transform_details: MT942 field 28C sequence number (after /) maps to Electronic Sequence Number. This represents the page or sequence number within the interim report.
mappings.notes: Extract second part of field 28C (after /) if present. If field 28C has no /, this element is omitted in MX.

mappings.transform_details: MT942 field 13D (date/time when report was generated) maps to Report Creation Date Time. Format: YYMMDD+HHMM (MT) to ISO 8601 date-time (MX). Convert YYMMDD to YYYY-MM-DD and HHMM to HH:MM:SS with assumed timezone.
mappings.notes: Field 13D format: YYMMDD+HHMM in local time. For camt.052, create ISO date-time: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS with timezone indicator. Timezone should be derived from institutional configuration or omitted (using local timezone).

mappings.transform_details: MT942 field 34F (floor limit currency and amount) indicates the threshold for individual transaction reporting. Can be mapped to a proprietary reporting source element or included in additional report information. camt.052 has no standard floor limit field.
mappings.notes: Field 34F format: Currency (3 alpha) + Amount (15d with comma). This is metadata about reporting thresholds, not account data. Consider mapping to RptgSrc/Prtry or AddtlRptInf with explanation.

examples.mx_value: RptgSrc/Prtry: 'Floor limit EUR 10000.00 - only transactions above this amount are detailed'

mappings.transform_details: Alternative mapping for MT942 field 34F: include floor limit information in Additional Report Information free-text field for context.
mappings.notes: Format as free text: 'Floor limit: EUR 10000.00 - transactions below this threshold are included in totals but not individually listed.' Helps recipient understand why some transactions may not be detailed.

mappings.transform_details: MT942 field 61 (Statement Line - transactions above floor limit) maps to an Entry (Ntry) element in camt.052. Each field 61 creates one Ntry. Field 61 has complex structure with 9 subfields that map to various Ntry subelements. Identical structure to MT940 field 61.
mappings.notes: Field 61 is repeating and complex. Only transactions ABOVE the floor limit (if 34F specified) are individually listed. Parse all subfields: value date, entry date, D/C mark, funds code, amount, transaction type, customer reference, bank reference, supplementary details. Each subfield maps to specific Ntry elements.

mappings.transform_details: MT942 field 61 value date (positions 1-6, YYMMDD) maps to Entry Value Date. This is the date on which the entry is valued (funds available/debited).
mappings.notes: Convert YYMMDD to YYYY-MM-DD format with century inference. Value date is when funds become available (credit) or are debited.

mappings.transform_details: MT942 field 61 entry date (positions 7-10, MMDD, optional) maps to Entry Booking Date. If entry date is omitted in field 61, it equals the value date. Combine entry date MMDD with year from value date.
mappings.notes: Entry date is optional (MMDD format). If present, combine with year from value date. If omitted, BookgDt equals ValDt.

examples.notes: Entry date 0211 (Feb 11) with year 2026 from value date

mappings.transform_details: MT942 field 61 D/C mark maps to Entry Credit/Debit Indicator. Lookup: C->CRDT, D->DBIT, RC->CRDT (reversal credit), RD->DBIT (reversal debit).
mappings.notes: D/C mark is mandatory. RC and RD indicate reversals. For reversals, set CdtDbtInd and also set Sts/Cd to 'RJCT' or use RvslInd.

examples.notes: Reversal of credit - set Rvsl element

mappings.transform_details: MT942 field 61 funds code (optional third character after D/C mark) maps to Entry Status. Omitted or blank -> BOOK (booked), D -> PDNG (pending - funds on hold).
mappings.notes: Funds code is optional. Most entries are booked (omitted funds code). 'D' indicates funds pending/held. MX Sts element uses codes: BOOK, PDNG, INFO, etc.

mappings.transform_details: MT942 field 61 amount (after funds code, format: up to 15 digits with comma decimal) maps to Entry Amount. The currency is typically same as account currency or derived from context.
mappings.notes: Convert comma decimal separator to period. Currency comes from account currency (field 25/25P context or field 34F if present), so Amt Ccy attribute uses report currency. Amount is unsigned (sign indicated by D/C mark).

examples.notes: Extract 1500,00, convert to 1500.00, currency from account/report context

mappings.transform_details: MT942 field 61 transaction type code (4 characters: 1 letter + 3 alphanumeric) maps to Bank Transaction Code Proprietary Code. Format: N=SWIFT codes, F=non-SWIFT codes, followed by 3-char type (e.g., NCHK=check, NTRF=transfer, NSTD=standing order, NDDT=direct debit).
mappings.notes: Preserve the full 4-character transaction type code. First char indicates SWIFT (N) or non-SWIFT (F). SWIFT bank transaction codes provide standardized type classification.

mappings.transform_details: MT942 field 61 customer reference (up to 16 chars after transaction type) maps to Transaction Details Account Servicer Reference. This is the reference for the account owner.
mappings.notes: Extract customer reference from field 61. Max 16 chars. This is the reference the customer sees on their interim report.
mappings.truncation_rule: MX AcctSvcrRef max 35 chars, MT field 61 customer reference max 16 chars. No truncation needed MT->MX.

mappings.transform_details: MT942 field 61 bank reference (optional, preceded by //, up to 16 chars after //) maps to Entry Reference. This is the bank's internal reference for the entry.
mappings.notes: Bank reference is optional in field 61. If present, extract after // delimiter (remove //). Max 16 chars in MT, max 35 in MX.

mappings.transform_details: MT942 field 61 supplementary details (optional continuation line, up to 34 chars) maps to Additional Entry Information. This provides extra details about the transaction.
mappings.notes: Supplementary details appear on a continuation line in field 61 (after CRLF). Max 34 chars. Map to AddtlNtryInf for free-text additional info.
mappings.truncation_rule: MX AddtlNtryInf max 500 chars, MT field 61 supplementary details max 34 chars. No truncation needed MT->MX.

mappings.transform_details: MT942 field 86 (up to 6 lines of 65 chars, max 390 chars) maps to Transaction Details Remittance Information Unstructured. Field 86 follows field 61 and provides additional information about the transaction (payer/payee name, remittance info, etc.). Identical to MT940 field 86.
mappings.notes: Field 86 can be unstructured free text or structured with subfield codes (?20, ?21-?29, ?30, ?32, ?60, etc.). If unstructured, map entire content to RmtInf/Ustrd. If structured, parse subfields and map to appropriate elements (Dbtr/Nm for ?32, Cdtr/Nm for ?60, etc.).
mappings.truncation_rule: MX RmtInf/Ustrd max 140 chars per line, multiple lines allowed. MT field 86 max 390 chars total (6 lines x 65 chars). May need to split or truncate.

mappings.transform_details: If MT942 field 86 contains structured subfield codes, parse and map to Related Parties elements. Common codes: ?30 (sender BIC), ?32 (sender name), ?33 (sender address), ?60 (beneficiary BIC), ?62 (beneficiary name), ?63 (beneficiary address). Map ?32/?33 to Dbtr, ?62/?63 to Cdtr.
mappings.notes: Field 86 structured format is bank-proprietary. Common subfield codes start with ?NN. If structured format detected, parse subfields and populate RltdPties (Dbtr, Cdtr, etc.). If unstructured, use RmtInf/Ustrd instead.

mappings.transform_details: If field 86 content doesn't fit cleanly into RmtInf or RltdPties, or if it contains narrative description (?20-?29 codes), map to Additional Entry Information as overflow.
mappings.notes: Field 86 ?20-?29 codes typically contain transaction description/narrative. Map to AddtlNtryInf for supplementary free-text info.

mappings.mt_field_name: Number and Sum of Debit Entries
mappings.transform_details: MT942 field 90D number of debit entries (first 1-5 digits) maps to Transactions Summary Total Debit Entries Number of Entries. This is the count of ALL debit transactions, including those below the floor limit.
mappings.notes: Field 90D format: NumberOfEntries(5n) + Currency(3a) + TotalAmount(15d). Extract number of entries. This count includes all debits, not just those listed in field 61.

mappings.mt_field_name: Number and Sum of Debit Entries
mappings.transform_details: MT942 field 90D total amount (after currency, 15d with comma) maps to Transactions Summary Total Debit Entries Sum. This is the sum of ALL debit amounts.
mappings.notes: Convert comma decimal separator to period. Extract total debit amount. This sum includes all debits, not just those listed in field 61.

mappings.mt_field_name: Number and Sum of Debit Entries
mappings.transform_details: MT942 field 90D currency (3 letters after number of entries) maps to Transactions Summary Total Debit Entries Sum currency attribute.
mappings.notes: Extract currency code (3 letters). ISO 4217 currency code.

mappings.mt_field_name: Number and Sum of Credit Entries
mappings.transform_details: MT942 field 90C number of credit entries (first 1-5 digits) maps to Transactions Summary Total Credit Entries Number of Entries. This is the count of ALL credit transactions, including those below the floor limit.
mappings.notes: Field 90C format: NumberOfEntries(5n) + Currency(3a) + TotalAmount(15d). Extract number of entries. This count includes all credits, not just those listed in field 61.

mappings.mt_field_name: Number and Sum of Credit Entries
mappings.transform_details: MT942 field 90C total amount (after currency, 15d with comma) maps to Transactions Summary Total Credit Entries Sum. This is the sum of ALL credit amounts.
mappings.notes: Convert comma decimal separator to period. Extract total credit amount. This sum includes all credits, not just those listed in field 61.

mappings.mt_field_name: Number and Sum of Credit Entries
mappings.transform_details: MT942 field 90C currency (3 letters after number of entries) maps to Transactions Summary Total Credit Entries Sum currency attribute.
mappings.notes: Extract currency code (3 letters). ISO 4217 currency code.

mt_only_fields.reason: MT942 field 28C combines report number and page/sequence number in single field (format: ReportNb/SeqNb). camt.052 separates these into LglSeqNb and ElctrncSeqNb. When translating MX to MT, must combine both elements into field 28C with / delimiter.

MT942 field 34F specifies threshold amount for individual transaction reporting. camt.052 has no standard floor limit field. Can be included in AddtlRptInf or RptgSrc/Prtry for context, but semantic meaning may be lost.

MT942 field 13D uses YYMMDD+HHMM format with + separator and local time (no timezone). camt.052 uses ISO 8601 date-time format. Conversion is straightforward but format differs. Timezone information must be added or assumed during translation.

mx_only_fields.default_strategy: Generate unique identifier (UUID or timestamp-based) at translation time. MT942 field 20 is report reference, not message ID.
mx_only_fields.reason: MT942 has no message-level ID concept (only report reference in field 20). camt.052 requires GrpHdr/MsgId for message identification.

mx_only_fields.default_strategy: Use field 13D if present (date/time indication), otherwise use current timestamp at translation time.
mx_only_fields.reason: MT942 field 13D provides report generation timestamp but camt.052 GrpHdr/CreDtTm is for message creation. Use 13D value or current time.

mx_only_fields.default_strategy: Can be derived from account owner information or institutional configuration. Optional element, can be omitted.
mx_only_fields.reason: MT942 is sent from bank to customer but doesn't explicitly identify the recipient in the message content. Recipient is implicit from message routing.

mx_only_fields.default_strategy: Use field 13D (date/time indication) if present, otherwise use current timestamp at translation time.
mx_only_fields.reason: MT942 field 13D provides exact date/time when report was generated. Map directly to Rpt/CreDtTm.

mx_only_fields.default_strategy: Use currency from field 34F (floor limit) or field 90D/90C (summary totals). All should have same currency.
mx_only_fields.reason: MT942 doesn't have explicit account currency field. Currency appears in field 34F and summary fields 90D/90C. camt.052 has Acct/Ccy to specify account currency once.

mx_only_fields.default_strategy: Omit. MT942 field 61 represents individual transactions, not batches.
mx_only_fields.reason: MT942 interim report lines (field 61) are individual transactions. camt.052 supports batch indicators in Btch element but MT942 has no equivalent.

mx_only_fields.default_strategy: Calculate as sum of TtlDbtNtries/NbOfNtries + TtlCdtNtries/NbOfNtries. Derive from fields 90D and 90C.
mx_only_fields.reason: MT942 has separate debit (90D) and credit (90C) totals but no combined total. camt.052 TxsSummary/TtlNtries can be calculated by adding debit count + credit count.

key_differences_from_mt940_camt053: MT942/camt.052 are interim/intraday reports, whereas MT940/camt.053 are end-of-day statements. MT942 can be sent multiple times during the business day.
MT942 has NO opening balance (60F/60M) or closing balance (62F/62M) fields. The focus is on transaction activity only, not account balances.

MT942 has floor limit indicator (field 34F) which specifies a threshold. Only transactions ABOVE this amount are listed individually in field 61. Smaller transactions are not detailed but ARE included in summary totals (90D/90C).

MT942 has summary totals (fields 90D and 90C) that provide number and sum of ALL debit/credit entries - both those listed in field 61 (above floor limit) and those not listed (below floor limit). This gives complete transaction picture without listing every small transaction.

MT942 has date/time indication (field 13D) with precise timestamp (YYMMDD+HHMM format) - critical for intraday reporting where multiple MT942 messages may be sent for same account at different times during the day.
Field 61 (Statement Line) and field 86 (Information to Account Owner) structures are identical to MT940 - same parsing logic applies.
camt.052 TxsSummary maps directly to MT942 fields 90D/90C, providing better semantic alignment than MT940/camt.053 where summary must be calculated.
MT942/camt.052 are used for real-time cash management, liquidity monitoring, and fraud detection - operational use case differs from MT940/camt.053 reconciliation focus.
